subject.title: feat(media): backfill, CDN-expiry retry, and once-mode drain fix

question: Should wacli accept this combined media-completeness feature set, including new backfill/retry commands, persistent unavailable-media state, and clean once/bootstrap drain behavior after the concrete review blockers are fixed?
rationale: The correctness fixes are mechanical, but the combined new command surface, migration semantics, and one-shot sync runtime behavior need maintainer product acceptance before merge.
